_comment: Overrides for scripts/appimage-notices.py, which release.yml and ci.yml run on
every product's AppImage after packaging. Every entry needs a reason. Paths in
'own' are AppDir-relative fnmatch patterns; license_files are relative to this
file. {placeholders} are filled from the AppImage runtime. A bundled file that no
host package owns and nothing here covers fails the step: add an 'own' entry for
the products' files, or a 'files' entry mapped to an 'extra' component with its

own.reason: The launcher the products' package-linux.sh writes into the AppDir
The desktop entry package-linux.sh writes at the AppDir root
Planchette's icon, resized from the app's own master icon
Séance's icon, resized from the app's own master icon
Poltergeist's icon, resized from the app's own master icon
Klabautermann's icon, resized from the app's own master icon
Planchette's Flutter bundle; its NOTICES, shipped readable as usr/share/doc/planchette/Third-Party-Notices.txt, covers the engine, packages and fonts in it
Séance's Flutter bundle; its NOTICES, shipped readable as usr/share/doc/seance/Third-Party-Notices.txt, covers the engine, packages and fonts in it
Poltergeist's Flutter bundle; its NOTICES, shipped readable as usr/share/doc/poltergeist/Third-Party-Notices.txt, covers the engine, packages, PDFium and fonts in it
Klabautermann's Flutter bundle; its NOTICES, shipped readable as usr/share/doc/klabautermann/Third-Party-Notices.txt, covers the engine, packages and fonts in it
The products' desktop entry, written by package-linux.sh
The products' icons, resized from each app's own master icon by package-linux.sh
The products' master icon, which package-linux.sh installs here when it cannot resize it

extra.name: AppImage type2-runtime
extra.license: MIT AND LGPL-2.1-only AND BSD-2-Clause AND BSD-3-Clause AND Zlib
sources: Statically links libfuse {libfuse_version} (LGPL-2.1, patched by patches/libfuse in the runtime source): https://github.com/libfuse/libfuse/releases/tag/fuse-{libfuse_version}
Statically links musl (MIT), zstd {zstd_version} (BSD-3-Clause) and zlib {zlib_version} (Zlib) from the Alpine Linux release named in the runtime source's scripts/chroot/chroot_build.sh
extra.reason: The runtime is the AppImage's ELF header, which appimagetool downloads; it sits outside the squashfs, so no host package owns it. Its texts are vendored from upstream (licenses/README.md); the runtime commit pins the exact sources.
